note: Reviewer records for the plan §19 items that qualify:wave4 marks review. A record names the literal item, the candidate commit and qualification run it reviewed, who reviewed it and the evidence checked. qualify:wave4 marks an item reviewed only when the record's candidate is the manifest's candidate and its result is checked; otherwise the record is attached as lastReview and the item stays review. scenarioRowsNotReviewedFull names the §15.2 rows whose browser step the review did not accept as full proof; the manifest attaches that finding to the row and leaves its suite status as it is. A person records a review in a reviewed change, or an agent does on the owner's explicit delegation, named in reviewer; CI never records one.

scenarioRowsNotReviewedFull.reason: the step never holds the atlas while it checks boot state, so it passes by construction
the browser is back online before any reconnect attempt runs offline
